title: The Power of Small Beginnings
subtitle: Start where you are and use what you have
description: An encouragement to begin faithfully, use what you have, and grow one step at a time.
quote: A seed does not need to look like a harvest before it is planted.
keywords: small beginnings start purpose faith courage Zechariah
assistantSummary: This article encourages readers not to despise small beginnings, but to start with what they have, remain faithful, and allow steady action to grow into something meaningful.
keyIdeas: Small beginnings can carry great potential.
Faithful action matters more than waiting for perfect conditions.
